channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Rep. Sewell votes for Iran War Powers Resolution
item.description: Representative Terri Sewell joined House members in voting to terminate unauthorized military action after President Donald Trump initiated war against Iran.

item.title: Senate passes bill to protect online privacy for young users
item.description: Senator Katie Britt praised the Senate's unanimous passage of legislation updating online privacy laws to better protect children and teenagers from modern data practices.

item.title: Faith leaders, family to march on State Capitol urging clemency for Sonny Burton
item.description: Faith leaders and Burton’s family will march to the Capitol Monday urging Governor Kay Ivey to grant clemency before the March 12 execution.

item.title: Alabama Senate Democrats criticize Republicans over partisan legislative calendar
item.description: Democratic lawmakers criticized the Alabama Senate's lack of minority-sponsored bills Thursday, arguing the Republican majority violated a long-standing precedent of legislative fairness.

item.title: House advances proposal to make Miss Alabama official state ambassador
item.description: Lawmakers unanimously advanced legislation to make Miss Alabama a voluntary state ambassador tasked with promoting civic engagement and goodwill.

item.title: House expands Capitol complex safety bill to restrict drones
item.description: The House substituted and amended SB231 on the floor to expand to "Capitol area" and restrict unmanned aircrafts from flying over.

item.title: Opinion | Alabama farmers are struggling. Alabama Democrats are trying to help
item.description: A cost-sharing program proposed by Democrats could be a lifeline to Alabama farmers.

item.title: Wes Allen faces constitutional residency questions as race heats up
item.description: Morgan County GOP leaders questioned whether Alabama Secretary of State Wes Allen met constitutional residency requirements while maintaining a home in Pike County.

item.title: Civil Rights leaders reaffirm commitment to justice at wreath-laying ceremony
item.description: Leaders honored 40 civil rights martyrs in Montgomery on Thursday, warning against modern efforts to suppress voting rights and reverse decades of progress.

item.title: Rep. Scott Stadthagen wins Alabama GOP chair after runoff vote
item.description: The former House majority leader defeated John Merrill at Saturday's winter meeting to lead Alabama Republicans into the 2026 election cycle.
